cells.gaps: No law, decree or policy in force on where state data is held has been found; the OeSD concession is not ratified and its data terms are not stated.
cells.note: The National Identification Registry's head announced in August 2026 that all national ID data will be stored in Liberia and that OeSD will not control it (LBR-001), an announced aim, so 2. No rule in force or system hosted nationally is shown, so not 3.
